blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Asian Development Bank (ADB) trimmed its growth outlook for the Philippines, citing heightened global uncertainties from a prolonged Middle East conflict and climate-related shocks. In its flagship Asian Development Outlook report published Wednesday, the ADB cut its 2026 growth estimate for the Philippines to 3.3 percent, from the prior forecast of 3.8 percent.
